correctness.rationale: For every k>=3, the published W_n block recursion and suffix pair (t_k(j),j) allow an exhaustive classification of all length-three factors: factors within blocks are inherited or k-shifted, and a triple crossing boundaries meets only one ordinary boundary except the separately analyzed early W1|W0|n transition. The six listed families A0,A1,I1,I2,T1,T2 contain all such boundary triples, with witnesses at stages 2,j,j+1,k+j-1 respectively; shifting whole embedded W_m by hk establishes the reverse inclusion and the exact finite-iterate stage formula. Independent direct-morphism vs stage-expression tests passed 44 (k,n) cases for k=3,4,5,6. This finite corroboration is not the proof for all k,n.

evidence: The 2026 paper explicitly proposes classification of length-m (m>=3) factors, including m=3, as a remaining question; its length-two occurrence formulas do not subsume the set of triples.
broader_coverage.reasoning: No inspected stronger classification is known; this is the first open case of a clearly motivated general problem.
